version 15.9
hostname rt-v03
!
vlan 10
 name sample-office
!
vlan 30
 name sample-transit
!
vlan 40
 name sample-camera
!
vlan 50
!
interface FastEthernet0
 switchport access vlan 10
!
interface FastEthernet1
 switchport access vlan 10
!
interface FastEthernet2
 description to sw-b01
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 10,30,40
 switchport mode trunk
!
interface FastEthernet3
 description to sw-b02
 switchport trunk allowed vlan 30,40,50
 switchport mode trunk
!
interface GigabitEthernet8
 ip address 203.0.113.6 255.255.255.252
!
interface Vlan10
 ip address 192.0.2.1 255.255.255.128
!
end
